changelog:
- Initial release of WhatsApp Business API integration via Maton platform.
- Supports sending messages (text, template, image, document, video, audio, location, contacts, and interactive button messages).
- Managed OAuth authentication for secure and seamless connection to WhatsApp Business accounts.
- Includes full connection management (list, create, get, delete connections) through Maton control panel API.
- API access via simple HTTP endpoints; includes cURL and Python code samples.
- Requires network access and a valid Maton API key.
